scope: Arithmetic group and Atkin-Lehner coset in the fixed D109 splitting, exact selected Brandt ideal correspondences, and certified transports moving the base vertex.

sources.title: Lassina Dembele, A hyperelliptic Shimura quotient of genus 16
sources.use: Geometric Cerednik-Drinfeld uniformization, two-layer Brandt graph, and Atkin-Lehner layer interchange. The paper's hyperellipticity claim is not invoked; D99 establishes the project's nonhyperelliptic conclusion.

sources.title: Marc Masdeu and Eloi Torrents, Fundamental domains for quaternionic S-arithmetic groups over totally real fields
sources.use: Norm-one S-arithmetic setting and column-lattice tree action. No full algorithm execution or degree-eight performance prediction.

local_sources.use: Read-only access to same-session ideal representatives and cached arithmetic correspondences. Their selected ideal inclusions are independently verified.
Confirms T[i,j] is the number of representatives tps[j,i]. The new matrix matches D99 entry for entry.
Saved 58-class matrix, stabilizers, and proved ordinary and narrow class numbers.
Certified unit signatures imply that totally positive units are squares.
Unchanged exact Hensel splitting and the norm-one unit u. All 629 D109 hashes are preserved.

project_deductions: Projective R-units have norm-parity quotient C2, whose kernel is the projective norm-one group, using D99's class and unit facts.
Class number one identifies the localized order normalizer modulo F-star with the projective R-unit group.
Seven exact ideal sandwiches along the saved odd closed walk supply an arithmetic odd-coset witness.
Normalizing that witness gives W=(1+b/2)i+cj with W^2=-(2+b), where c=(b^7-7b^5+14b^3-7b)/2.
The W and W*u*W-inverse actions move the base vertex by seven and fourteen edges, with certified lattice transitions.
The product u*(W*u*W-inverse) has norm one and trace of valuation -7, proving hyperbolic translation length fourteen.
excluded_inferences: No complete fundamental domain, generating set or finite edge-reduction implementation.
No invariant harmonic cocycle, actual moments, dyadic CM/frame labeling or Shimura tangent/jet.
No new level, additional Hecke prime or expansion of the existing 58-class census.
No candidate identification or target field polynomial.
